text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... My body fat percentage
went way up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Lately, Ines, you've been eating snacks in our room
a lot after coming back from your jobs, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When you handle food at a part-time job,
you just can't help wanting to eat it yourself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I know how you feel,
but if you eat that much, you've got to burn it off.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: By the way, Ryan-chan, what's your body fat percentage?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You wanna see? Let's take a measurement, then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—That's it!
I'm going on a diet starting today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll join in too!
First up, 100 squats!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —No, I have to at least do that much!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Ryan-chan!
I swear I'm gonna lose the weight—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Mejiro Ryan's help,
Ines Fujin successfully finished her diet.
